import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split('\n')
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx])
    idx += 1
    
    cities = []
    for _ in range(n):
        cities.append(data[idx].strip())
        idx += 1
    
    city_to_idx = {city: i for i, city in enumerate(cities)}
    
    adj = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        adj[i][i] = 1
    
    num_links = int(data[idx])
    idx += 1
    
    for _ in range(num_links):
        parts = data[idx].strip().split()
        idx += 1
        city1, city2 = parts[0], parts[1]
        i1 = city_to_idx[city1]
        i2 = city_to_idx[city2]
        adj[i1][i2] = 1
        adj[i2][i1] = 1
    
    print(' '.join(cities))
    
    for i, city in enumerate(cities):
        row = [city] + [str(adj[i][j]) for j in range(n)]
        print(' '.join(row))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
